node.statement: Define Delta(X):=b*Delta-prime(X)*b. This map is CP: at every matrix level, conjugation by I_q tensor b preserves positivity, and Delta-prime is CP. It is unital because Delta(I)=b*a*b=I. Hence Delta is UCP by def-ucp-map; every amplification Delta_q is itself UCP and therefore contractive, so ||Delta_q(Y)|| <= ||Y|| for all q and Y.
